name: Rice Flour Pancakes (Pitha)
instructions: 1. Mix rice flour with enough water to form a smooth, medium-thick pouring consistency batter. Add a pinch of salt.
2. Heat a heavy-bottomed pan or tawa and lightly brush it with mustard oil.
3. Pour a ladleful of batter onto the center of the pan and spread it slightly in a circular motion.
4. Cook on medium heat until the bottom is golden brown and crispy.
5. Flip and cook the other side until done.
6. Serve hot, traditionally paired with spicy chutneys or lentil curries.
description: Rice flour pancakes, commonly referred to as a variation of 'Pitha', are a staple in Tripuri households. They reflect the agrarian lifestyle of the state, where rice is the primary crop. These pancakes are versatile, often served as a breakfast item or a quick snack, bridging the gap between simple home cooking and traditional festival foods.
